import datetime,hashlib,json,re,traceback,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("D:/github/my/E-Track")
base=root/".cache/p3-8-implementation-20261021/.cache/p38/takeover-20261022"
candidate="27048aa10079d8dd01d608967e7b5d1b473861ba"
def fingerprint(path):
    path=path.resolve(strict=True)
    relative=path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b""):
            h.update(block)
    return {"path":relative,"bytes":path.stat().st_size,"sha256":h.hexdigest()}
def audit():
    out={"schema":"p38-remediation-original-review-v1","checked_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"candidate":candidate,"formal_acceptance":"NOT_RUN","new_builds":0,"device_operations":0,"development":[]}
    for host,counts in (("ubuntu",{"passed":746,"skipped":16,"failed":0}),("windows",{"passed":729,"skipped":33,"failed":0})):
        paths=list((base/("run-39789686610/"+host+"/.cache/flutter-dev-checks/runs")).glob("*/result.json"))
        assert len(paths)==1,host
        path=paths[0]
        data=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert data["source_before"]["head"]==candidate and data["source_before"]["clean"]
        restored=data["source_after_restored"]
        assert restored["head"]==candidate
        assert not restored["dirty_semantic"] and not restored["dirty_untracked"]
        if not restored["clean"]:
            assert restored["dirty_eol_only"]==["app/bluetooth_flutter_Trace/windows/flutter/generated_plugin_registrant.h"]
        assert data["source_deltas_bound_toolchain_regen"]
        assert data["scope"]=="all" and data["development_result"]=="PASS" and data["formal_acceptance"]=="NOT_RUN"
        assert data["diagnostics_complete"] and data["lockfile_unchanged"]
        item={"host":host,"run_url":data["github_run_url"],"run_attempt":data["github_run_attempt"],"report":fingerprint(path),"source_before":data["source_before"],"source_after":data["source_after"],"source_after_restored":restored,"semantic_restoration_verified":True,"source_deltas_bound_toolchain_regen":data["source_deltas_bound_toolchain_regen"],"scope":data["scope"],"lock_sha256":data["lock_sha256_before"],"toolchain_regen":data["toolchain_regen"],"commands":[]}
        for command in data["commands"]:
            assert command["status"]=="PASS" and command["exit_code"]==0 and not command.get("timed_out",False),command["name"]
            log=path.parent/command["log"]
            record={"name":command["name"],"argv":command["argv"],"exit_code":command["exit_code"],"timed_out":command.get("timed_out"),"log":fingerprint(log)}
            assert record["log"]["bytes"]==command["diagnostics"]["log_bytes"],str(log)
            text=log.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
            if command["name"]=="tests":
                summary=text.splitlines()[-1]
                match=re.search(r"\+(\d+)\s+~(\d+): All tests passed!",summary)
                assert match,summary
                actual={"passed":int(match[1]),"skipped":int(match[2]),"failed":0}
                assert actual==counts==command["diagnostics"]["test_counts"],actual
                record.update({"raw_summary":summary,"counts":actual,"remediation_cases":[{"line":i,"text":line} for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if "P38-R0" in line]})
            elif command["name"]=="sdk_version":
                item["sdk"]=command["diagnostics"]["sdk_identity"]
                for field in ("frameworkVersion","frameworkRevision","dartSdkVersion","engineRevision"):
                    assert item["sdk"][field] in text,field
            elif command["name"] in ("analyze","apk_device_ota_native","apk_verify","apk_build"):
                record["tail"]=text.splitlines()[-12:]
            item["commands"].append(record)
        out["development"].append(item)
    native=base/"run-39789686610/ubuntu/app/bluetooth_flutter_Trace/build/app/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/TEST-com.wen.gaia.gaia.DeviceOtaServiceTest.xml"
    suite=ET.parse(native).getroot()
    cases=suite.findall("testcase")
    assert suite.attrib["tests"]=="18" and len(cases)==18
    assert all(suite.attrib[k]=="0" for k in ("skipped","failures","errors"))
    assert not suite.findall(".//failure") and not suite.findall(".//error") and not suite.findall(".//skipped")
    out["native"]={"report":fingerprint(native),"attributes":suite.attrib,"cases":[case.attrib for case in cases]}
    meta_path=base/"run-39789686610/apk/run-079972b527294600b78a85f9779a1c74/artifacts/trace-dev-debug.json"
    meta=json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected={
      "run-39789686610/apk/run-079972b527294600b78a85f9779a1c74/artifacts/trace-dev-debug.apk":"0e89bd52a1b9a4c6bb073c692e7af6c94cdc12b10053aaade4381b44f163f97c",
      "standard-build/android/ble-monitor-android.apk":"366a1e1c898b8729392ce86b159501592f66ee33ac19a243ca92b7117f31a026",
      "standard-build/windows/ble-monitor-windows.exe":"30ee419ccc6bd3fb12c5aa3fcb9e9d3b89537ab1dc62467c7460ba5a677c0046",
      "standard-build/windows/ble-monitor-windows.zip":"286526d10b7feba76cbeaeccb13c6e30247d98f70fd6920f81c6bffbf30499c0",
      "standard-logs.zip":"01832f796fd52deafbad5c734a0eaa0a9153c6fe3c5a00eef6d8698b91bccd1c"}
    out["artifacts"]=[]
    for name,digest in expected.items():
        record=fingerprint(base/name)
        assert record["sha256"]==digest,name
        record["matches_handoff_sha256"]=True
        out["artifacts"].append(record)
    apk=out["artifacts"][0]
    assert meta["commit"]==candidate and meta["sha256"]==apk["sha256"] and meta["bytes"]==apk["bytes"] and not meta["release_signing"]
    out["debug_metadata"]={"report":fingerprint(meta_path),"metadata":meta}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(base/"standard-build/windows/ble-monitor-windows.zip") as archive:
        assert archive.testzip() is None
        names=archive.namelist()
        main_sha=hashlib.sha256(archive.read("ble_monitor.exe")).hexdigest()
        assert main_sha==expected["standard-build/windows/ble-monitor-windows.exe"]
        assert "flutter_windows.dll" in names and any(n.startswith("data/") for n in names)
        out["windows_distribution"]={"crc":"PASS","entry_count":len(names),"embedded_exe_sha256":main_sha,"entries":names}
    out["standard_logs"]=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(base/"standard-logs.zip") as archive:
        assert archive.testzip() is None
        for name in archive.namelist():
            if not name.endswith(".txt") or not any(s in name for s in ("Build release APK","Build Windows release","Run Flutter tests","Analyze project","Checkout repository")):
                continue
            raw=archive.read(name)
            text=raw.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
            decisive=[{"line":i,"text":line} for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if any(s in line for s in ("tests passed,","No issues found","Built build","Warning:","warning:","Already watching path",candidate))]
            out["standard_logs"].append({"entry":name,"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"decisive":decisive,"warning_lines":sum("warning:" in line.lower() for line in text.splitlines())})
    archive_inputs=[
      ("dev-ubuntu.zip","f6686b81c12785cb514cad269db2fbc706e2b1cec69374dbdf7fa987975e7d5f","run-39789686610/ubuntu"),
      ("dev-windows.zip","85db52dc473ad15ac43ed8f4a925a3dc25eafcb90eb6027dd7ead798394856dd","run-39789686610/windows"),
      ("dev-apk-resume.zip","b31bf8e4616d7640d5dd6b822377848c984f6bdbe96f3fc90bcf5f9559a522d5","run-39789686610/apk"),
      ("standard-apk-python.zip","5c5770ded1f2af6d9dc9f358b27cc77421575ae13e0b9b99faf37e01fd9dae44","standard-build/android"),
      ("standard-windows.zip","0981217abe334491faaeee042bdd2f3c8862f97e68cfa3a8fa80336b5267c3a2","standard-build/windows")]
    retained=[a for a in out["artifacts"] if not a["path"].endswith("standard-logs.zip")]
    retained += [out["native"]["report"],out["debug_metadata"]["report"]]
    for item in out["development"]:
        retained.append(item["report"])
        retained.extend(command["log"] for command in item["commands"])
    out["github_archive_bindings"]=[]
    for name,digest,destination in archive_inputs:
        record=fingerprint(base/name)
        assert record["sha256"]==digest,name
        record.update({"published_sha256":digest,"members_checked":[]})
        with zipfile.ZipFile(base/name) as archive:
            assert archive.testzip() is None,name
            for item in retained:
                path=root/item["path"]
                if not path.is_relative_to(base/destination):
                    continue
                relative=path.relative_to(base/destination).as_posix()
                matches=[n for n in archive.namelist() if n==relative or n.endswith("/"+relative)]
                assert len(matches)==1,(name,relative,matches)
                member=archive.read(matches[0])
                assert len(member)==item["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(member).hexdigest()==item["sha256"],(name,relative)
                record["members_checked"].append(relative)
        out["github_archive_bindings"].append(record)
    out["result"]="ORIGINALS_VERIFIED_NOT_FORMAL_ACCEPTANCE"
    return out
try:
    print(json.dumps(audit(),ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
except Exception as error:
    frame=traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)[-1]
    print(json.dumps({"result":"ORIGINAL_AUDIT_ERROR","error_type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error),"line":frame.lineno,"check":frame.line}))
    raise SystemExit(1)
evaluator.kind: One-off read-only adaptation of the prior originals audit. Not an admitted formal runner; full source retained here rather than only in ignored cache.

commands.kind: Read-only fixed Git objects; four product files and three test files.
Independent offline evaluation of original CI/log/XML/artifact bytes; no new tests or build.
Public read-only GitHub API requests; no authentication/configuration change or filesystem cache.
Public read-only API metadata; existing ZIP bytes checked, not downloaded again.
Public package archive read in memory only, pinned SHA-256 check, no extraction/install or Dart execution.
Read-only status after checking the worktree .git pointer. No global safe.directory or index write.

preparation_failures.reason: Node child_process spawnSync git returned EPERM; used the existing direct shell Git reader, not a permission override.
The initial in-memory 8 MiB cap was too small. HEAD gave Content-Length 14561823; a bounded 16 MiB read then matched the lockfile archive digest.
cmd.exe rejected the overlong inline reader before Python execution. The same bounded reader was placed in the preflighted project cache with apply_patch.

Initial reader incorrectly required source_after_restored.clean on Windows. The existing runner records a pure generated-header EOL difference and no semantic/untracked changes. Corrected the reader against existing semantic-state rules, retained the real false clean flag.
Default Git rejected the administrator-owned worktree. Its .git pointer was checked, then only a command-local safe.directory was used for read-only status; no global config was written.
